questions.question: A field is declared with no access keyword. Which classes can use it?
options: Any class in the same package
questions.explanation: No keyword means default (package-private) access: the class itself and every class in the same package.

questions.question: Which access modifiers can a top-level class use?
questions.explanation: A top-level class is public or package-private. Only nested classes, which are members, can be private or protected.

questions.question: Which list goes from the most restrictive to the least restrictive access?
questions.explanation: private allows one class, default adds the package, protected adds subclasses elsewhere, and public allows everyone.

questions.question: Parent has public void board(). Child writes void board() { } to override it. What happens?
options: It compiles and board() becomes package-private
It compiles, but only as a new overloaded method
It throws IllegalAccessError at run time
Compile error: attempting to assign weaker access privileges
questions.explanation: An override cannot narrow access. Leaving out the keyword makes it default, which is narrower than public.

questions.question: class A { private String tag() { return "A"; } String show() { return tag(); } } class B extends A { String tag() { return "B"; } } What does System.out.println(new B().show()); print?
questions.explanation: B cannot see A's private tag(), so B.tag() is a new method, not an override. show() inside A calls A's own tag().

questions.question: class Pass { private int seat; Pass(int s) { seat = s; } boolean same(Pass o) { return seat == o.seat; } } What does System.out.println(new Pass(4).same(new Pass(4))); print?
options: Compile error: seat has private access
questions.explanation: private is checked per class, not per object. Code inside Pass may read the private field of any Pass object.

questions.question: In package lounge, class Vip extends airline.Flight, which has protected int seats. Inside Vip, which line fails to compile?
questions.explanation: From another package, a subclass can use a protected member only through its own type, not through a plain Flight reference.

questions.question: When are access modifiers checked?
options: Only when the garbage collector runs
By the compiler, when the source is compiled
Each time a field is read at run time
questions.explanation: javac rejects illegal access while compiling, so correct programs pay no run-time cost for these checks.

questions.question: A file Gate.java contains public class Gate { } and public class Lounge { }. Why does it fail to compile?
options: Class names must start with a verb
A file cannot hold more than one class
Only one top-level class per file can be public, and it must match the file name
questions.explanation: Lounge is public but the file is Gate.java. Make Lounge package-private or move it to Lounge.java.

questions.question: Which modifier fits a helper method that only its own class should ever call?
questions.explanation: private keeps the helper hidden from every other class, so it can be renamed or rewritten safely later.
